positive.prompt: Draw a web application with an API, Postgres database, and Redis cache. Give me the preview and edit links.
positive.expected_behavior: Generate the requested components and connections. Return preview and edit links, or explain any linkError without claiming publication succeeded.

positive.description: Edit a diagram in the same working session
positive.prompt: In the diagram you just created, rename the API to Checkout API.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the previous workingSessionId, inspect state if needed, rename the API and preserve the other components. Return the updated links.

positive.prompt: Rearrange the current diagram from top to bottom.
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse the workingSessionId and lay out the existing diagram top-down without adding or removing components.

positive.description: Draw a private canvas with precise placement
positive.prompt: Start a new private diagram. Put a card named Browser at x=0, y=0 and a card named API at x=320, y=0. Connect Browser to API. Do not publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the two cards and connection with publish:false. Return the working session and report that no public preview was created.

positive.prompt: Create an architecture diagram from the chatgpt template and give me the preview link.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply the advertised chatgpt template and return preview and edit links, or explain an actual tool failure.

negative.description: Unsupported payment: explain that ArchDraw diagrams systems and cannot transfer money; do not call diagram tools to perform a payment.
negative.prompt: Use ArchDraw to transfer money from my bank account.

negative.description: Unavailable private diagram: ask for user-supplied context or an authorized working session; do not invent access or guess identifiers.
negative.prompt: Open another user's private ArchDraw working session. I do not have its identifier or permission.

negative.description: Unsupported repository deletion: explain that canvas removal operations only remove diagram elements and cannot delete repository files.
negative.prompt: Use ArchDraw's remove operation to delete the frontend directory from my repository.
